technology_name: A COMPOSITION OF SUSTAINABLE CONCRETE CONTAINING STAINLESS STEEL MILL SCALE FINE AGGREGATES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: The intensive illegal dredging of natural river sand for civil construction fine aggregates collapses riparian river ecosystems and drives building material costs upward.
description: An advanced, eco-friendly green concrete mix architecture formulated by replacing up to 25% of standard fine natural sand aggregates with processed, non-hazardous industrial stainless steel mill scale particles, maintaining an M30 strength class and a 0.45 water-to-cement balance.
applications: Structural building concrete slabs, sustainable commercial foundations, urban storm drainage culverts, and pre-cast utility piping infrastructure.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
